sonnet.problem: The card opens with "Instead," which says the visiting of iniquity replaces leaving the guilty unpunished. Verse 7 joins the two lines with "Yet" and a semicolon and does not say how they connect.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: Four jokes share one punchline shape, "Moses does a big thing, but I can't manage the small version": stop 1 card 3 (looking for my hat at the bottom of the mountain), stop 1 card 6 (one cookie box and rethinking my life), stop 2 card 16 (cranky when the oven runs late) and stop 3 card 12 (my face only shows flour).
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
